say:1:1033717001:1.text: I was going to pick flowers in Vaduso Mountains with my friend Mimily, who lived here... But that was before all the bad stuff happened.
say:1:1033717001:1.source_cn: 我和这个村子里的米米丽约定好，要一起去瓦度索山脉采花…...
say:1:1033717001:1.male: I was going to pick flowers in Vaduso Mountains with my friend Mimily, who lived here... But that was before all the bad stuff happened.
say:1:1033717001:1.female: I was going to pick flowers in Vaduso Mountains with my friend Mimily, who lived here... But that was before all the bad stuff happened.

say:2:1033717002:1.text: After everything went wrong, I couldn't find her, and then I found out the whole village had to leave.
say:2:1033717002:1.source_cn: 腐化发生了，她杳无音讯，我才得知村里人已经都逃离了。
say:2:1033717002:1.male: After everything went wrong, I couldn't find her, and then I found out the whole village had to leave.
say:2:1033717002:1.female: After everything went wrong, I couldn't find her, and then I found out the whole village had to leave.

say:3:1033717003:1.text: But this is still her home, and I know my friend will be back someday. That's why I come here whenever I can!
say:3:1033717003:1.source_cn: 这是她的家，她一定会回家。我一有时间就来这里看看，说不...
say:3:1033717003:1.male: But this is still her home, and I know my friend will be back someday. That's why I come here whenever I can!
say:3:1033717003:1.female: But this is still her home, and I know my friend will be back someday. That's why I come here whenever I can!
